forced_sales.price_effect: NOT QUANTIFIED: no defensible Australian conversion from extra forced sales to a national price fall (evidence report B)

evidence_inputs.B: price elasticity dropped; local effects: 27% foreclosure discount and about 1% spillover at 0.05 miles (B1); Sydney -0.87% [-1.48, -0.26] per extra concurrent listing within 250 m, Blacktown (B4); US crisis benchmark 10% more homes on the market ~ 4 points (B2), not transferable

C2.note: 2019-20, includes holiday homes; upper bound on investor exposure

evidence_inputs.F1: bank share of the excess profits tax base not disclosed in ECR-2025-3194
evidence_inputs.G: no causal Australian evidence on the rent response to forced investor sales; direction not established
